description: This file defines a final class 'Middleware' in the 'Aws' namespace, providing various static methods to create and manipulate middleware functions for AWS SDK requests, including features like request signing, validation, retries, logging, and request modification.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate AWS SDK middleware functions for request handling, such as signing, validation, retries, and logging.

methods.name: sourceFile
methods.description: Creates middleware that replaces a command parameter with a stream from a source file for upload.

methods.name: validation
methods.description: Adds client-side validation middleware for commands.

methods.name: requestBuilder
methods.description: Builds an HTTP request using a provided serializer function.

methods.name: signer
methods.description: Creates middleware that signs AWS SDK requests using provided credentials and signature functions.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that invokes a callback for debugging or logging without modifying the request.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Wraps a handler with retry logic based on a decider and delay functions.

methods.name: invocationId
methods.description: Adds a unique invocation ID header to requests for tracking.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Adds Content-Type header to requests based on file extension.

methods.name: recursionDetection
methods.description: Adds trace ID headers in Lambda environments to detect recursive invocations.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Tracks request and command history for testing.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Applies a mapping function to requests passing through the middleware.

methods.name: mapCommand
methods.description: Applies a mapping function to commands passing through.

methods.name: mapResult
methods.description: Applies a mapping function to results of commands.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Tracks the duration of request handling for performance metrics.
